B3_offline_after_convergence.criterion_boundaries: what this cell scores is the document: does it render, on which generation, and does moving inside it still work.  The app's own data reads are not cached by the worker on this surface, so an offline read failing is reported in rendered_offline_text and scored neither as a pass nor as a defect here.  Worker update checks survive Playwright's offline emulation (measured: ["/v10-sw.js", "/workbox-6923124b.js"]), so they are counted apart from page traffic rather than as proof the app reached the network.
